TITLE.value: UCAS and International Admissions to Enrolment - Granular BPMN Lite

Purpose.value: Granular BPMN-lite model showing ungrouped actors, systems, hand-offs, and data exchanges for UK domestic undergraduate admissions through UCAS and international direct/agent admissions from course registration to student enrolment.

Scope.value: Domestic UK undergraduate admissions via UCAS and international admissions via direct university and authorised agent channels; includes course publication, application, assessment, immigration/CAS pre-checks, offers, applicant replies, deposits/evidence, results or condition confirmation, clearing, record creation, enrolment and induction handover.

ArchitecturePattern.value: Student Records/SIS is the authoritative applicant-to-student record and outcome system; UCAS, direct application portals, agent channels, CRM, Curriculum, Finance, Accommodation, Identity, Immigration Compliance/CAS and Student Services own their domain processes and exchange confirmed data with SIS.

CycleExample.value: September intake cycle; dates expressed as relative UK UCAS lifecycle windows

ReferenceAlignment.value: Revelation Student Records reference model: Student Records as authoritative system, UCAS admissions exchange, finance/SLC, accommodation, identity, wellbeing and statutory reporting boundaries.

DecisionGatewayModellingStandard.value: Every decision gateway is modelled as an explicit BPMN-lite XOR gateway with at least two outgoing routes. Each outgoing interaction is labelled with RouteLabel, GatewayType and Condition metadata. Gateways include owner, rule, timeframe and policy/source metadata.

DecisionGatewayAudit.value: PASSED: all decision gateways have at least two outgoing labelled routes, including international source, sponsorship and CAS readiness routes.
